confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two web searches (one for the RBA rate, one for Innsbruck prices). The price search returned crowdsourced Numbeo-based figures as of June 2026: a €16.66 inexpensive meal, €75.49 for a three-course meal for two, a €5.21 draught beer and a cappuccino of about €4.2. I converted euros to USD at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is my assumption and not a sourced rate. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices were not found directly. I estimated them from the local beer price, with the cocktail at about 2x beer and the wine glass at about 1x beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Innsbruck's high-season July demand. I did not inspect any booking pages or listings, so they are the least certain. The RBA 19 Nov 2026 value came from the statistics table. The RBA overview and RSS feed still showed 18 Nov (0.6720), probably cached.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Innsbruck's own aggregated price indexes. Accommodation is set against other Alpine and Austrian tourist cities such as Salzburg, with a July high-season uplift.
